snippet.title: Occlude Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
An occult game of Solitaire. Demo available NOW as part of Steam Next Fest! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3547010/Occlude/

Passed down between generations, lost to dark rooms and hidden spaces, now Occlude finds its way to you. You thought you knew the rules. You don't.

Follow Pantaloon on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Pantaloon?action=follow
